class ProcessNet.Model.Body

Represents a rigid body in the multibody system.

Methods

GetMass()

Returns the mass of the body.

SetMass(value)

Sets the mass of the body.

GetInertia()

Returns the inertia tensor.

SetInertia(ixx, iyy, izz)

Sets the inertia tensor components.

GetPosition()

Gets the current position of the body center of mass.

SetPosition(x, y, z)

Sets the position of the body center of mass.

GetVelocity()

Returns the linear velocity vector.

GetAngularVelocity()

Returns the angular velocity vector.

AddMarker(name, position)

Adds a marker to the body at the specified position.

GetMarkers()

Returns list of all markers attached to this body.

GetID()

Gets the unique identifier of the body.

GetName()

Gets the name of the body.

SetName(name)

Sets the name of the body.

GetType()

Returns the type of the body (Rigid, Flexible, Ground).

Delete()

Deletes the body from the model.

Properties

Mass

Gets or sets the mass value.

IsGround

Read-only property indicating if this is the ground body.
